content: Claude CLI MCP config: 'claude mcp add turbo-mcp --transport sse http://127.0.0.1:PORT/sse' registers an SSE-transport MCP server. Scope can be project (--scope project, stored in .mcp.json) or user (--scope user). Each group's parent claude must be launched with this server pre-configured. The Turbo app can write a per-session .mcp.json in the group's cwd before spawning the parent claude process, pointing at the embedded MCP server's localhost URL. HTTP transport also available.
